WITH RECURSIVE inheritance_tree AS (
  -- Anchor: classes that directly name ApiModel in their class statement
  SELECT
    s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id,
    1 AS depth
  FROM code.symbols s
  JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
  WHERE cb.base_name = 'ApiModel'
  UNION ALL
  -- Recursive step: find classes that inherit from a class already in the tree
  SELECT
    s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id,
    it.depth + 1 AS depth
  FROM inheritance_tree it
  JOIN code.class_bases cb ON cb.base_symbol_id = it.class_symbol_id
  JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
  WHERE cb.base_name != 'ApiModel'  -- exclude ApiModel itself from the recursive step
),
min_depths AS (
  SELECT
    class_symbol_id,
    MIN(depth) AS depth
  FROM inheritance_tree
  GROUP BY class_symbol_id
)
SELECT
  class_symbol_id,
  depth
FROM min_depths
WHERE depth > 1
ORDER BY depth, class_symbol_id;

request:
Which classes inherit from ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/models.py) only indirectly, i.e. through at least one intermediate class of this repository, and do not name ApiModel directly in their class statement? An import alias of ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/responses.py imports it as _Payload) counts as naming ApiModel directly, and a subscripted base such as ListResponse[T] counts as its class. For each, give the class symbol ID and the length of the shortest inheritance chain to ApiModel (2 when the parent class directly subclasses ApiModel).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), depth (integer).
explanation: The query first identifies classes that directly name ApiModel in their class statement (depth 1). It then recursively traverses the inheritance graph to find all indirect subclasses, computing the minimum depth for each class. Finally, it filters to keep only classes with depth > 1 (i.e., indirect subclasses) and returns their symbol IDs and shortest chain length.

  JOIN code.class_bases cb ON cb.base_symbol_id = it.class_symbol_id
  JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
